note: Takes an RX semaphore on purpose (cdc0 on Firefly_H757, urt0 elsewhere, which is the console only where the console runs on urt0): the console never answers again, and the LEDs show the characters it receives. 'Synchro ...' is printed for each character received, so the row types one; on Firefly_H757 it also writes 'RX event' on KSERIAL_RX.

tests.note: the application watches urt0 on every board but Firefly_H757 (cdc0); on Asmodee_H747 the console is cdc0 and urt0 is the FT4232 wire that also carries the CM7 core dumps, so the character is typed there
